fields.title: Lalupon Oyo State  Medical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical and medical outreach was conducted at Lalupon, Ibadan from November 27–28, 2025. The two-day program was organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach in partnership with the Christian Medical Fellowship (CMF), Narrow Path Christian Church, and other ministry leaders and volunteers. The outreach was designed to meet both the physical and spiritual needs of the Lalupon community.

Over the two days, free medical services were provided to residents with limited access to healthcare, alongside the preaching of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Through prayers, counselling, and compassionate care, many lives were touched, bodies were healed, and souls were won for Christ. Medical professionals, counsellors, and evangelical team members served selflessly throughout the mission.

fields.title: Gbaremu Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted at Gbaremu, Ibadan on November 26, 2025, organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach in collaboration with ministry partners and volunteers. The program focused on proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ while extending compassion and care to vulnerable members of the community.

During the outreach, the message of salvation was preached with clarity and power, resulting in a strong spiritual response. A total of 48 individuals gave their lives to Christ, and 52 widows were identified for welfare support, reflecting the ministry's commitment to holistic outreach that addresses both spiritual and social needs.

fields.title: Olode Medical & Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical and medical outreach was conducted at Olode, Ibadan from February 21-22, 2025. The two-day program was organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach in collaboration with RUCOMEF/CMF, NTCM Olode, and the Christian Medical and Dental Association (CMDA). The outreach brought together medical professionals, volunteers, and ministers committed to meeting both the spiritual and physical needs of the Olode community.

Over the course of two days, free and accessible healthcare services were provided to residents with limited access to medical care, alongside the clear and compassionate preaching of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. A total of 26 volunteers, including medical professionals, counsellors, and evangelical team members, served selflessly throughout the outreach. Through coordinated evangelism, medical care, and prayer, lives were touched, bodies were healed, and souls were won for Christ.

fields.title: Eleyele Evangelical & Medical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical and medical outreach was conducted at Eleyele, Ibadan from February 18–19, 2025. The two-day program was organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach in collaboration with RUCOMEF / CMF, CAC Oke Imole, and the Christian Medical and Dental Association (CMDA). The outreach brought together medical professionals, volunteers, and ministers united in addressing both the spiritual and physical needs of the Eleyele community.

Over the two days, free and accessible healthcare services were provided to residents who otherwise have limited access to medical care, alongside the clear and compassionate preaching of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. A total of 32 volunteers, comprising medical professionals, counsellors, and evangelical team members, served diligently throughout the outreach. Through coordinated evangelism, medical care, and prayer, many lives were touched, bodies were healed, and souls were won for Christ.

fields.title: Ileba Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted at Ileba, Ibadan from February 16-17, 2025, organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach in collaboration with ministry partners and volunteers. The two-day program focused on proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ while demonstrating practical Christian love within the Ileba community.

Across both days, the message of salvation was preached with clarity and compassion, resulting in a strong spiritual response. A total of 94 individuals gave their lives to Christ, comprising both adults and children. As part of the outreach, Bibles were distributed to new converts, and food items (bags of rice) were shared with attendees, reflecting the ministry's commitment to holistic outreach that addresses spiritual and physical needs.

fields.title: Kajiado & Rift Valley Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted in Kajiado and Solai, Rift Valley, Kenya from June 22-24, 2024. The multi-location program was organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach as part of its international mission expansion, under the theme "Receive Him." The outreach focused on proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ across underserved communities.

Over the three days, evangelism activities were carried out at Kambi Moto Shopping Centre, Raizambo Barak, and the Solar Energy Centre in Solai. Through preaching, prayers, and compassionate engagement, many lives were touched, resulting in a strong spiritual response across the communities. A total of 106 individuals gave their lives to Christ, testifying to God's mighty move throughout the outreach.

fields.title: Olomi Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:

Through evangelistic preaching, prayers, and personal ministration, the Gospel was shared with clarity and compassion. Many lives were touched, faith was strengthened, and hearts were drawn closer to Christ through the ministry.

fields.title: Agodi, Iyana-Church Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:

The outreach focused on proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ and strengthening Christian faith within the community.

Through evangelistic preaching, prayers, and personal ministration, the Gospel was shared with clarity and compassion. A total attendance of 80 individuals was recorded, with 26 people giving their lives to Christ, testifying to God's mighty move throughout the outreach.

fields.title: Orimerunmu Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted at Orimerunmu, Mowe, Ogun State on February 23, 2024, organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach under the theme "In His Presence." The outreach focused on proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ and strengthening Christian faith within underserved communities.

Through worship, evangelistic preaching, prayers, and compassionate engagement with attendees, the Gospel was shared with clarity and compassion. A total attendance of 140 individuals was recorded, with 33 people giving their lives to Christ, testifying to God's mighty move throughout the outreach.

fields.title: Kenya Week-long Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted in Nairobi and Kisii, Kenya from September 15-23, 2023, marking Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach's maiden mission to Kenya. The week-long program was organized to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ across multiple locations and to minister to vulnerable communities, including children in orphanages.

The outreach began in Nairobi, followed by a visit to the King's Kid Village Orphanage, where a significant number of children surrendered their lives to Christ. Evangelistic activities continued in Kisii, culminating in a powerful ministration at Mooso, Kisii. Through preaching, prayers, and compassionate engagement, many lives were touched, resulting in a strong spiritual response across the communities.

fields.title: Mapo Hall Evangelical & Medical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical and medical outreach was conducted at Mapo Hall, Idi Arere, Ibadan from March 16-17, 2022, marking Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach's maiden Evangelical Health Mission. The two-day program was organized under the theme "Moment of Decision" in collaboration with RUCOMEF / CMF, local pastors, and community counselors. The outreach brought together medical professionals, volunteers, and ministers committed to addressing both the spiritual and physical needs of the Idi Arere community.

Over the two days, free and accessible healthcare services were provided to residents with limited access to medical care, alongside the clear and compassionate preaching of the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Through coordinated evangelism, medical care, and prayer, many lives were touched, bodies were healed, and souls were won for Christ. This historic outreach set the foundation for Optimizing People's integrated evangelism-and-healthcare mission model.

fields.title: Weija Leprosarium Evangelical Outreach
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted at Weija Leprosarium, Accra, Ghana on October 26, 2021, organized by Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach in collaboration with Pastor Kayode. The outreach focused on ministering to individuals living with leprosy while demonstrating Christ-like compassion and care.

During the outreach, prayers and the Gospel message were shared with residents of the leprosarium. Food items were donated to support the physical needs of the residents, and spiritual encouragement was offered through personal ministration. The outreach team also met Father Campbell, strengthening international ministry relationships and reaffirming the mission's commitment to reaching marginalized communities.

fields.title: Aba Alfa Village Crusade
fields.description:
An evangelical outreach was conducted at Aba Alfa Village, Ibadan on October 17, 2020, marking the first official crusade of Optimizing People Evangelical Outreach. The program was organized under the theme "Jesus is the Answer" in collaboration with Pastor Kayode and Rev. Raphael. This foundational outreach represented the birth of the ministry's mission to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ and bring spiritual transformation to underserved communities.

Through evangelistic preaching, prayers, and personal ministration, the Gospel was shared with clarity and compassion. Community members gathered in significant numbers, resulting in a strong spiritual response. Many lives were touched, faith was strengthened, and hearts were drawn closer to Christ, laying a solid foundation for future outreaches.
